notes.title: KILL KNIGHT – KRYSTALIZED UPDATE OUT NOW
notes.notes:
Knights, 

The KRYSTALIZED UPDATE is here!

We’re excited for you to dive into the latest KILL KNIGHT update, which brings with it a host of thrilling new content for you to unlock and unleash - from powerful new weapons and equipment, to the new WEEKLY DESCENT and an updated SEVER mode. Plus, delve deeper into the lore with the Demonic Kodex and enjoy listening to the KILL KNIGHT Original Soundtrack while lifting weights, doing maths, managing your finances, or whatever else you mortals do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971089/28c64ace2987e57929783de408b0e00a002c8558.png

Here are the highlights:

New KNIGHT EQUIPMENT
New Pistols

 INCULCATORS
 Fires puncturing shards that spike into enemies, causing a supercombine explosion
New Heavy Weapon

 DREADFALLER
 Combusting laser caster that emits a beam of plasma that ruptures enemies, causing micro-detonations
New Sword

 HOLLOWBRANDT
 An unholy regalia, the shape of which unties the souls of demons
New Armor

 UMBRARITE
 Forged within the abyss, a cursed aspect that echoes with forgotten carnage
New Augment

 METICULOUS AZURITE
 Firing Wrath Bursts restores some Heavy Ammo
New Augment

 ABYSSAL FLOURITE
 Quick Absorb also attracts Health Shards, with reduced distance

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYnpsNmF4bjdqMTByNjNpazBtc2N5cHFta241M29mcTBtcDM3a2VtNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/T1smIKMCq51AvLc7ej/giphy.gif

NEW DEMONIC KODEX

 The Demonic Bestiary

 Spend Tokkens to unlock entries and reveal information on every Demon, including enemy traits, exploits, and lore!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971089/4448fa19ac6ace1b5cdbe0370573c675b496afa1.png

NEW WEEKLY DESCENT MODE

 Claim the highest score and beat your friends in the new WEEKLY DESCENT Mode, where random combination of equipment pieces and layers will be selected each week
 Leaderboard refreshes weekly!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971089/be5e1f2b1c92f80afd660e588d3b24cc6076dec7.png

UPDATED SEVER MODE
SEVER mode has been updated to provide a deeper level of challenge!

 New Krystalized Demons

 These enhanced enemies unleash new attacks, and have increased speed and health
 Killing them before they despawn grants an extra burst of Carnage Score
  
 Enhanced Hazards

 Traps such as Lasers, Spike Traps, and Blood Bombs are more deadly
  
 Updated Spawn Patterns

 Tweaked to enhance flow and maintain momentum
 
https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb2VseTFtY2RuODZrZjMzdjh4aGFyeXB0d2MycTg4MXE4aTB6ZHZjdyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/vt1WFo6KGCw247P39U/giphy.gif 

 KILL KNIGHT Original Soundtrack
The Official KILL KNIGHT Original Soundtrack is now available to purchase on Steam (and coming soon to major streaming platforms). Stimulate your senses with over an hour of music across 14 nerve-rattling and hand-crafted tracks that will allow you to truly dance with Death.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971089/1d82bd4fd49c0916a414f0b895e2f9ea239a3a47.png
We can’t wait for you to jump into the new update, plus we can also confirm that KILL KNIGHT will be taking part in Steam's Winter Sale!

See you in the otherworld…

The KILL KNIGHT team

—————

Full v1.2 Patch Notes 

Changes

General Balance

 Carnage Score Challenge Badges

 Slightly reduced Carnage score requirement for some Layers
  
 Speed Demon Challenge Badges

 Slightly reduced Par time for some Layers
  
 REGRET Difficulty

 Reduced difficulty of multiple aspects for REGRET difficulty
  
 ACOLYTE Difficulty

 Slightly reduced difficulty of multiple aspects for ACOLYTE difficulty
  
 Laser Beam Traps

 Reduced damage by 20%
 
Enemies

 General 
 Mortar Projectiles now have a consistent travel speed across all distances
  
 ZEEKER

 Explosion damage slightly decreased
  
 ABYSSAL SPHERE Hexagons

 Health slightly decreased
 Slightly more Blood Gems when destroyed
  
 ABYSSAL SPHERE Lasers

 Laser damage collider size decreased for all lasers in “Laser Show” attack
  
 OBELYSK

 Physical collision radius decreased
  
 WRAITH II

 Reduced attack damage by 20%
  
 PURSUER I / II / III

 Reduced attack damage of Pulse Attacks by 20%
 
Equipment

 HOLYBANE

 Wrath Burst Projectile lifetime increase
 Wrath Charge requirement increased
  
 RUINSHOT

 Wrath Burst Projectile damage increased
  
 ARCHBLIGHT

 Wrath Burst Projectile zap radius slightly decreased
  
 FLUXSTRIKERS

 Base Fire Rate increased
 Overdrive duration decreased
  
 SOULRENDERS

 Fire Rate ramp up delay decreased
 Overdrive duration increased
 Overdrive bullets knockback decreased
 Max Ammo amount increased
  
 KILLBLADE

 Sword Trigger damage size increased
 
Equipment Unlock Goals

 SOULRENDERS

 Changed from “Complete Solitude without lowering Kill Power once” to “Complete any Layer with Maximum Kill Power Level“
  
 HADESURGE

 Changed from “Complete Viscera without dashing through a laser” to “Complete Viscera without being damaged by any Laser“
 
General UI

 SEVER Mode is now hidden on the Layer Select screen until it is Unlocked
 Brand new Unlock animation for Unlocking SEVER Mode
 Layer Select Screen

 New Layer Unlock Visual Sequence
  
 Equipment Screen

 New Equipment Unlock Visual Sequence
  
 Settings Menu

 Reorganized order of Options
  
 Main Menu

 New Visual treatment of the Main Menu background 
 
Settings

 Borderless Window mode is now the default window mode setting

Miscellaneous

 New Difficulty & Tutorials Popup

 If the player dies many times in succession, a popup will appear suggesting to lower the difficulty and / or complete all of the Tutorials
  
 Abyssal Sphere Boss Fight

 Heavy Ammo, Wrath Charge and Kill Power are fully refreshed when starting the ABYSSAL SPHERE battle, including when using a Checkpoint
  
 Various minor localization changes
 General performance and stability improvements

Fixes
Enemies

 Fixed instances of ZEEKER enemies appearing during the Final Boss fight
 Fixed instances where PURSUER animations would break
 TURREKTs can no longer navigate out of bounds on various layers
 Fixed an issue that would cause the game to soft-lock when executing a GHAST III
 Fixed an issue causing the Pulse Attack status to linger on PURSUER and TURREKT enemies
 Fixed an issue where the Final Boss Hexagons from Phase 1 would appear during Phase 2

Equipment

 Fixed an issue where HOLYBANE’s Ricochet was not bouncing off of certain walls in SOLITUDE
 Fixed instances where some projectiles could clip through enemies without damaging them
 Fixed an issue where RUINSHOT’s Wrath Burst would explode without contacting a visible enemy during the Final Boss fight

Abyssal Layers

 Fixed multiple areas in Layers where players could get out of bounds
 Fixed multiple instances of certain enemies spawning in unnavigable areas of VISCERA
 Fixed rare cases of navigation blocking issues that occur after a layer phase transition

Goals and Scoring

 Fixed an issue where game time continued to update while watching the Ending Cutscene
 Players are now no longer able to mistakenly earn Challenge Badges on SEVER mode
 Equipment Goal UI now properly shows which active Goals are still achievable during a run
 Fixed an issue where the player could fail the “Speed Demon” goal by a matter of milliseconds

General UI

 Fixed an issue where the 'Tutorial Complete' text failed to align properly after completing any tutorial in Japanese language
 Fixed UI overflow on the Equipment screen for certain languages
 Fixed various privacy policy issues
 Popups no longer have textured backgrounds
 Removed dotted texture from Weapon hover over highlights
 Fixed the health bar PFX sometimes glitching
 Fixed various missing strings
 Fixed an issue where the Kill Stream UI would turn off before the Kill Stream was actually ended
 Fixed an issue causing the Unlock PFX to not trigger when buying equipment
 Fixed an issue with the Heavy Ammo UI bar not properly filling
 Fixed an issue where players couldn’t access the back button on the Credits screen on Steam Deck
 Fixed the fast forward sometimes button not working on the Credits screen
 Updated the wording for some Post-run Challenges

Audio & Music

 Fixed an issue where the ‘Level Start’ audio clip would play at the beginning of a tutorial level

Accessibility

 Fixed an issue where the Health bar would mistakenly appear blue instead of green when the ‘Flicker Reduction’ option is enabled

Leaderboards

 Fixed an issue where leaderboard placements above 10 would not properly display ‘Old Best’
 Fixed an issue causing leaderboards to constantly scroll even when there is no user input
 Fixed an issue where UI elements would be permanently highlighted

Settings

 There is no longer a slight delay when opening the settings menu

Miscellaneous

 Fixed an issue where dying at the same time as the Final Boss would soft-lock the game
 Fixed an issue where the player would spawn facing away from the Final Boss
 Fixed an issue causing the Final Boss VO and subtitles to not be in sync

Platform Specific
PC

 Fixed an issue in the Tutorials menu where a tutorial would stay highlighted even when not visible on screen
 Fixed ‘New Best’ text overlapping with the player’s score in Japanese and Russian
 Fixed an issue where the game would minimize when not in focus on Borderless mode
 Fixed ‘Submit’ text appearing instead of a button icon on the Controller Disconnected popup
 Fixed incorrect navigation on drop down menus when using keyboard and mouse input
 Fixed the spacebar icon clipping over boundary box
 Fixed an issue causing friends to not appear correctly on Leaderboards when switching Steam accounts
 Fixed dpad/joystick inputs not registering on Leaderboard screens
 Fixed various UI elements not appearing as intended on widescreen monitors


—————

notes.title: KILL KNIGHT Soundtrack & Game Update, Coming 18 December
notes.notes:
Knights,

We have some big announcements to make for KILL KNIGHT, so strap in and read ahead.

First, we are excited to reveal that the KILL KNIGHT Original Soundtrack will be releasing this year. On December 18th at 2pm PST / 5pm EST, you will be able to pick up the OST separately or as part of a bundle with the game, and our plan is to also release it on major streaming platforms in the near future. We know that an OST has been long-requested by you all, and soon you’ll truly be able to dance with death in the Abyss. 

This incredible Soundtrack has been carefully hand-made and remastered with all of the music from the game, with plenty of decadent surprises included. Whether it’s for a deep work session, or pumping iron - prepare yourselves for next week’s release by checking out the full track list below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971089/40ba4afb504693fadee2a4b29b7f3288ebae54d9.png
Second, on the same day as the OST release, KILL KNIGHT will also be receiving a new game update! This content update has been made possible by all of you suffering Knights who have given us the energy and power to add even more to the game. With it comes powerful new Equipment, a WEEKLY DESCENT challenge mode, the DEMONIC KODEX, several changes to SEVER Mode (including Krystalized Demons!) to test our most dedicated Knights, and a castle full of bug fixes and balancing changes. We recently provided more detail about the new weapons and augments in Dev Diary #7, but stay tuned for even more info soon.

Thank you for your incredible support of KILL KNIGHT. Your dedication makes updates like this possible and we cannot wait for you to fight against what we’ve cooked up.

Until then, see you down in the Abyssal Keep…

The KILL KNIGHT team

—————

notes.title: KILL KNIGHT - 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hi Knights,

It's been great to see you diving deep into the Abyssal Keep!

In case you missed it, our Lead Game Designer Sean, shared a message  here on behalf of our development team for everyone who has played KILL KNIGHT and joined our community to date.

We have a new patch available now (v1.0.1), bringing updates to the game which are outlined in the list below.

Stay tuned for a game update soon.

HOTFIX NOTES

IMPROVEMENTS

Player

 Graphical improvements to Pulse Counter effect

Equipment

 Logic to handle goal unlocks completing and failing while playing on SEVER
 Equipment stat bars have had the amount of pips increased from 5 > 10 to improve readability
 Trait descriptions relating to Equipment stats have been removed from Equipment descriptions
 Trait Icon visuals have been improved 
DEMIGUARD now has proper visuals for its Wrath Explosion
 ARCHBLIGHT’s Wrath Burst cost has been increased from 73 > 95 Power Gems
 ARCHBLIGHT’s Wrath Burst’s sphere projectile lifetime has been reduced from 12 > 9 seconds    
 Equipment goal objectives updated for TWILIGHT AMETHYST - Kill Stream required has been reduced from 999 > 555
 Equipment goal objectives updated for HEAVENS QUARTZ - Carnage required has been reduced from 20,000 > 15,000
 Equipment unlock Tokken costs have been slightly reduced across the board

General UI

 Implemented fallback for input actions to handle displaying actual input in the case of no prompts (previously "MISSING_PROMPT {0}") - This should show the input as plain text now if nothing is available
 Rebinding support for movement for keyboard and mouse (defaulted to WASD)
 Improved spacing and padding of the new movement controls found in Settings
 Fixed Privacy Policy text misalignment

Audio & Music Additions

 Re-mixes to Abyssal Sphere battle music tracks

Miscellaneous

 Leaderboard improvements to now scroll in pages and not 1 by 1 as it did before
 Performance and memory allocation improvements 

Accessibility

 UI Flicker Reduction & High Readability Font Accessibility options added


Fixes
Enemies

 QUAKER II now has the correct health value and gives the correct amount of sword charge and score on death
 HIVEN Power Gem absorbing has been improved
 TURREKTS now correctly bounce off Blood Bombs
 Blood decals now properly appear when enemies are killed by Traps
 Ground visual effects on GHASTS & Boss have been fixed
 Abyssal Sphere subtitles behavior has been fixed when observed during Hyper Drive
 Fixed Abyssal Sphere dialogue on death

Player

 Addressed situation where Player could Wrath Absorb during any sword attack
 Timescale has been fixed when performing Hyper Drives
 Player visual effects now correctly scale at the right simulation speed if there were timescale changes during any specific effects

Abyssal Layer

 Game time now correctly pauses during the bridge sequence

Scoring

 Requirements for achieving individual Abyssal Layer ranks has been addressed

Equipment

 Scenario fixed where certain Heavy Weapons projectiles were missing enemies when shot at point-blank range
 Fixed an issue where JUDGECANNON’s wrath projectiles were exploding immediately upon performing a Wrath Burst next to a wall or Gyro Blade
 ARCHBLIGHT’s Wrath Burst explosion no longer fires off multiple times

General UI

 Fixed issue where Goals UI was not syncing with actual data after a checkpoint reset
 Fix for missing input definitions for mouse/keyboard bindings
 Addressed left & right stick press input sprites that were getting mixed up on rebinds
 “New Best” UI animation fixes

Audio & Music

 REFLECTION music no longer cancels out randomly
 Boss music track now loops correctly
 Addressed Execution tutorial where some QUAKER I sounds were not playing
 Drop-downs were not playing the select sound when clicking with the mouse
 Teleport sound no longer doubles up when going from the bridge to the Boss

Achievements

 “Kill X Demons” Achievements no longer increment multiple times per kill 
 Achievements for completing all Abyssal Layers at a higher difficulty now unlock for lower difficulties or mixed difficulties
 Beating all Abyssal Layers on a higher difficulty unlocks the Achievement on all lower difficulties (e.g. Knight completion should unlock Acolyte and Regret completion).
 Beating all Abyssal Layers on mixed difficulties unlocks lower difficulty Achievements (e.g. Levels 1-3 on Acolyte then, Levels 4-5 on Regret, should unlock Regret all Abyssal Layers completion).

Leaderboards

 Leaderboard entries now correctly load on the overview section
 Fixed an issue that broke end of level Leaderboards 
 Fixed rapidly changing Leaderboards not showing correct data
 Addressed font issues on Leaderboards when swapping back and forth between accessible & normal fonts

Miscellaneous

 Fixed a crash that occurred when closing the game upon just finishing a run
 Updated localization strings in several areas: Network Error, DIVINATION, Movement Key Rebinds, Sword Attack & Sword Surge Rebinds
 Traditional Chinese localization fixes 
 Language drop-down missing character box text
 Setting screen keyboard controls navigation has been fixed
 Fixed an issue where game would lock on start sometimes
 Mortars no longer Z-Fight 
 Fixed a disconnect popup that was hidden during splash screen and was causing bad input behavior
 Accessibility font is now only available for non-fallback font locales
 Fixed issue where resolution would revert when in windowed mode
 Other miscellaneous fixes


Known Major Issues

 We have made some improvements to try and address a black screen bug players were getting but if this still occurs, please let us know!
 We have also made some Player movement input fixes. If you come across any issue with movement, please let us know as well!


—————

KILL KNIGHT  is available on Steam now - and is now fully optimised for Steam Deck compatibility.
